source_clock: Existing Kodi CDVDDemuxFFmpeg::ConvertTimestamp subtracts AVFormatContext.start_time; this engine code remains unchanged
strict_comparison: Normalized source and HLS presentation timestamps within0.002sec; no widened tolerance
transport_epoch_meaning: One fixed positive timestamp origin for the entire HLS rendition, not a wait/delay. Source packet PTS/DTS spacing and A/V relationship are preserved. HLS maps the rendition to a zero-based movie clock; actual Android MediaPlayer seek/playback must verify that.
negative_source_start: Read and normalized from container metadata; valid AAC priming is supported
verified_local: H264/AAC encoded packets, decoded video/audio, source-derived random seeks and timestamps
HEVC/AAC encoded packets, timestamps and HLS/fMP4 decode
unsupported: DTS and unapproved audio codec families fail explicitly
Missing/ambiguous tracks, missing/sparse cues and non-IDR/open-GOP fragment starts fail safely
